sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH LOCATED OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS EARLY THIS MORNING WILL DIG SEWD AND AMPLIFY AS IT ENTERS THE UPPER MS VALLEY LATER THIS EVENING...AND THEN PROGRESSES EWD TOWARD THE GREAT LAKES REGION DURING THE OVERNIGHT. AHEAD OF THE UPPER TROUGH...AN EML WILL SPREAD FROM THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS ACROSS A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AIRMASS OVER THE MIDWESTERN STATES. AS A COLD FRONT ADVANCES SEWD FROM THE NRN PLAINS INTO THE MS VALLEY AND CNTRL PLAINS DURING THE AFTERNOON...SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE LIKELY.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY/WRN GREAT LAKES SWWD INTO THE CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: MCS LOCATED OVER THE WRN/CNTRL DAKOTAS EARLY THIS MORNING IS FORECAST TO ENTER PORTIONS OF MN BY MID MORNING. OTHER STORMS OCCURRING WITHIN WAA REGIME TIED TO A 30 KT LLJ WERE SPREADING E ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS...AND WILL LIKELY MOVE INTO ERN IA BY MIDDAY. A MIDLEVEL IMPULSE COINCIDENT WITH THE IA CONVECTION WILL MOVE ESEWD INTO LOWER MI AND THE MID OH VALLEY BY AFTERNOON...AND MAY AID IN AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES. BEHIND THE DEPARTING MORNING STORMS...SWLY WINDS AT 850 MB WILL AID IN ADVECTING A WARM EML AIRMASS NEWD TOWARD THE MS VALLEY. RICH MOISTURE WITH SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE 70S/PW VALUES LOCALLY NEAR 2.0 INCHES IS FORECAST TO BE PRESENT FROM ERN NEB INTO SRN MN AND WRN IL. GIVEN MORNING CLOUDS/CONVECTIVE DEBRIS CLEARS THE AREA...STRONG HEATING WILL YIELD MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 3000 J/KG OVER MUCH OF THE REGION. BY MID AFTERNOON...A COLD FRONT IS FORECAST TO BE LOCATED FROM NERN NEB INTO E-CNTRL MN. THIS FRONT WILL ACCELERATE SEWD DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING AS AN UPPER TROUGH DIGS FROM THE NRN PLAINS ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY. FRONTAL FORCING COMBINED WITH THE VERY MOIST/UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF THUN

sections.title: SERN AZ
sections.text: STRONG SURFACE HEATING COMBINED WITH CLIMATOLOGICALLY HIGH PW VALUES NEAR 1.5 INCHES WILL AID IN MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1000 J/KG OVER SERN AZ THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. THIS WILL FAVOR THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE MOUNTAINOUS TERRAIN...WHICH MAY SPREAD WWD WITH TIME GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF LOW-LEVEL WLY FLOW SURMOUNTED BY 20 KT OF MIDLEVEL ELY FLOW. MARGINAL STORM ORGANIZATION IN THE FORM OF MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND SMALL LINES WILL BE POSSIBLE...AND MAY POSE AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS. ..GARNER/SMITH.. 07/09/2013

sections.title: MID-UPPER MS VALLEY TO ERN NEB/NRN KS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A COMPLICATED SCENARIO IS UNFOLDING THIS MORNING WITH ONGOING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS ACROSS MN/IA IN ASSOCIATION WITH A LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND MCV. MEANWHILE...THE PRIMARY SYNOPTIC TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT ARE FARTHER BACK TO THE NW ACROSS THE DAKOTAS/MT. IT APPEARS THAT THE ONGOING STORMS IN MN/IA WILL PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY WHILE DEVELOPING EWD/SEWD ALONG THE PRIMARY WARM FRONT THAT EXTENDS NW-SE FROM CENTRAL MN TO SRN WI. THE CONVECTION WILL BE FED BY A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH 68-72 F DEWPOINTS...AND RESULTANT MLCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG. HOWEVER...THE STORMS WILL TEND TO OVERTURN THE RICHEST CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE RELATIVELY EARLY IN THE DAY ACROSS CENTRAL/SE MN...ERN IA...SRN WI...AND NRN IL. VERTICAL SHEAR IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG WITHIN THE UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR IN ADVANCE OF THE STORMS THIS MORNING BASED ON VWP/S AND 12Z SOUNDINGS. THUS...WHILE SOME DAMAGING GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE INITIAL STORMS...THIS EARLY CONVECTION COULD DETRIMENTALLY IMPACT THE POTENTIAL FOR MORE SIGNIFICANT SEVERE STORMS LATER THIS AFTERNOON AS THE PRIMARY SYNOPTIC WAVE AND COLD FRONT MOVE SEWD ACROSS ERN SD AND MN INTO IA THIS EVENING. SOME LOW-LEVEL RECOVERY

sections.title: SE AZ THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: AN OVERNIGHT MCS IS DISSIPATING OVER SONORA AND S CENTRAL AZ. GRADUAL CLEARING OF CLOUD DEBRIS FROM E TO W WILL OCCUR TODAY...AND THIS WILL LEAD TO STRONGER SURFACE HEATING/DESTABILIZATION AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF SE AZ...AND STORMS WILL SUBSEQUENTLY MOVE SWWD TOWARD THE LOWER DESERTS IN A DEEP ELY/NELY FLOW REGIME TO THE NW OF WEAK MIDLEVEL WAVE MOVING W OF THE TX BIG BEND. THE TYPICAL INVERTED-V BOUNDARY LAYER...IN COMBINATION WITH MODERATE BUOYANCY...COULD SUPPORT A FEW DOWNBURSTS WITH STRONG/DAMAGING OUTFLOW WINDS. ..THOMPSON/LEITMAN.. 07/09/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST ACROSS PORTIONS OF EAST-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST MN INCLUDING THE MINNEAPOLIS-ST PAUL METRO AREA THROUGH MID-MORNING...ALTHOUGH A MORE ORGANIZED SEVERE THREAT COULD EVOLVE INTO PORTIONS OF WI BY LATE MORNING/MIDDAY. A WATCH ISSUANCE IS NOT IMMINENT GIVEN THE ANTICIPATED MARGINALITY IN THE SHORT-TERM...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS MORNING...A STRONG/PERIODICALLY SEVERE NORTH-SOUTH ORIENTED CONVECTIVE LINE CONTINUES TO PROGRESS EASTWARD AT AROUND 35 KT ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL MN AS OF 1145Z. BACKGROUND REAR-INFLOW/EMBEDDED MCV CHARACTERISTICS ARE EVIDENT WITH THE CONVECTIVE LINE AS WARM/MOIST ADVECTION...AIDED BY THE TERMINUS OF A MODERATE SOUTHWESTERLY LOW LEVEL JET FROM THE MIDDLE MO VALLEY INTO IA...OTHERWISE CONTINUES TO THE NORTH OF A FRONT THAT EXTENDS ACROSS IA TO NEAR AND JUST NORTH OF THE WI/IL BORDER. NEAR THE SOUTHERN PORTION OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE...A 50 KT WIND GUST WAS MEASURED AROUND 1109Z AT REDWOOD FALLS MN. AFOREMENTIONED ORGANIZATIONAL CHARACTERISTICS WILL LIKELY MAINTAIN THE CONVECTIVE LINE EASTWARD ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST MN AND INTO WESTERN WI THIS MORNING. A RELATIVELY MODEST FORWARD MOTION OF THE MCS AND CONSIDERABLE LOW-LEVEL CINH /REFERENCE NEAR-SURFACE STABLE LAYER PER 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM MINNEAPOLIS/ SHOULD CONTINUE TO HINDER THE POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE-CALIBER WIND GUSTS. THAT SAID...SOME ADDITIONAL ACCELERATION/FORWARD PROPAGATION IS POSSIBLE AMID MODERATE LOW-LEVEL STORM-RELATIVE EAST-SOUTHEASTERLY WINDS...AND LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE REGARDLESS. WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL COULD INCREASE AS EARLY AS LATE MORNING/MIDDAY INTO WI AT THE BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT MAY CONTINUE LATE THIS MORNING INTO EARLY THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NRN AND CNTRL WI. ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED BUT CAN NOT BE ENTIRELY RULED OUT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS IN NW WI IS LOCATED JUST AHEAD OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY IN THE UPPER MS VALLEY. THE CONVECTIVE LINE IS ALSO LOCATED ON THE NRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG RANGE. AS LARGE-SCALE ASCENT CONTINUES TO SPREAD EWD AHEAD OF THE AXIS OF THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH...THE LINE MAY CONTINUE TO BE SUSTAINED ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF NRN WI. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR SEWD ALONG THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT INTO CNTRL WI. AS SFC TEMPS CONTINUE TO WARM AND LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES STEEPEN...THE LINE COULD REMAIN MARGINALLY SEVERE WITH A POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER CORES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS NRN IND..OH AND SRN LOWER MI THIS AFTERNOON. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR THIS SITUATION FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF WW ISSUANCE LATER THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE IS BEGINNING TO INCREASE ACROSS NRN IND AND NCNTRL OH AS SFC TEMPS HAVE WARMED ITO THE LOWER TO MID 80S F. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUGGESTS THAT MLCAPE VALUES ARE NOW ESTIMATED TO BE IN THE 1500 TO 3000 J/KG RANGE FROM SRN LOWER MI SWD TO NEAR THE OH RIVER. ALTHOUGH DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS NOT THAT STRONG...REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS DO SHOW 20-25 KT OF FLOW AT 850 MB. THIS COMBINED WITH STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND PRECIPITABLE WATER VALUES AROUND 2 INCHES MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR WET DOWNBURSTS AS CELLS PULSE UP AND DOWN OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY STRONG DOWNBURSTS ARE POSSIBLE WITH TSTMS THAT EVOLVE ACROSS WRN KS THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO RAPID SFC HEATING ACROSS WRN/CNTRL KS THIS AFTERNOON. LATEST OBSERVATIONAL DATA INDICATES TEMPERATURES HAVE SOARED TO 104-108F ALONG A SW-NE ORIENTED SFC BOUNDARY WHICH EXTENDS FROM WEST OF GCK TO NEAR RSL. HIGH BASED CONVECTION HAS RECENTLY DEVELOPED/DEEPENED ALONG THIS CORRIDOR PER GRADUALLY EXPANDING PRECIP CORES. GIVEN THE WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR ACROSS THIS REGION THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD PROPAGATE SLOWLY ESEWD INTO A HIGH PW AIR MASS CHARACTERIZED BY VALUES IN EXCESS OF 1.5 INCHES WITH SFC TEMP/DEW POINT SPREADS ON THE ORDER OF 50F. THERE IS SOME CONCERN THAT ISOLATED DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS WILL ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER PRECIP CORES...ESPECIALLY IF CLUSTERING OCCURS. SEVERE COVERAGE MAY REMAIN TOO SPARSE TO WARRANT A SEVERE TSTM WATCH...BUT WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR FOR FURTHER STRENGTHENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SMALL CLUSTER OF STORMS OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN IN E-CNTRL AZ WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE WSWWD AND POSSIBLY GROW UPSCALE AND POSE A THREAT FOR MICROBURSTS CAPABLE OF SEVERE WIND GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MOISTURE RICH AIRMASS SAMPLED BY THE 12Z TUS AND GREATER PHOENIX RAOBS AND 20Z GPS PW SITES OVER CNTRL AND S-CNTRL AZ...SHOW PW OVER THE SONORAN DESERT IN EXCESS OF 1.75 INCHES. KIWA RADAR IMAGERY AS OF 2150Z SHOWS ECHO TOPS 40-50 KFT OVER GILA AND GRAHAM COUNTIES...INDICATIVE OF UPDRAFT VIGOR. SINGLE SITE 88D VWP DATA SHOW 20-25 KT NELY FLOW AROUND 10 KFT ABOVE SEA LEVEL. FURTHERMORE...STRONG DIABATIC HEATING IS RESULTING IN TEMPS TO CONTINUE TO RISE INTO THE LOWER 100S OVER S-CNTRL AZ AND THE GREATER PHOENIX METRO...YIELDING MODERATE BUOYANCY /2000 J/KG MLCAPE/ WITH STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. IF STORMS AND THEIR ASSOCIATED COLD POOLS/OUTFLOWS LEAD TO UPSCALE GROWTH AS THE STORMS MOVE FROM THE HIGHER TERRAIN INTO THE LOWER DESERT...THEN A RISK FOR SEVERE WIND-PRODUCING MICROBURSTS WILL CONCURRENTLY INCREASE AND PROMPT STRONG CONSIDERATION FOR A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS OVER DISCUSSION AREA MAY OFFER RISK OF ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND STG/DAMAGING GUSTS THROUGH ABOUT 02Z. CONDITIONAL/BRIEF TORNADO POTENTIAL CANNOT BE RULED OUT. MAIN LIMITING FACTORS WILL BE COVERAGE/DURATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWED PRIMARY LOW OVER NWRN WI NEAR HYR...WITH COLD FRONT SSWWD ACROSS SERN MN AND CENTRAL/SRN IA. WELL-DEFINED CONFLUENCE LINE AND DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING BOUNDARY FROM EARLIER CLOUDS/CONVECTION WERE ESSENTIALLY COLLOCATED NEAR BMI-OSH LINE THEN CURVING NWWD BETWEEN AIG-RHI AND INTO SFC LOW. WEAKER/PREFRONTAL CONFLUENCE LINE WAS DRAWN FROM NERN IA NEAR VOK-AUW LINE. WIND SHIFTS ACROSS COLD FRONT AND WRN CONFLUENCE LINE ARE GRADUAL...AND CONVERGENCE GENERALLY DECREASES WITH SWWD EXTENT. THIS APPEARS TO ACCOUNT FOR LACK OF DEEP TOWERS IN VIS IMAGERY OVER SWRN WI SWWD INTO IA. VEERING SFC FLOW AND DECREASE IN SFC INSOLATION INDICATE LIKELIHOOD OF DEVELOPMENT FROM SWRN WI INTO IA SHOULD LESSEN WITH TIME THROUGH REMAINDER AFTN. HOWEVER...MINIMAL CINH WITHIN NRN RIM OF FAVORABLY STG BUOYANCY IS FAVORING ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER PORTIONS CENTRAL/SWRN WI NEAR WRN CONFLUENCE LINE. RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND SWWD INCREASE IN BOUNDARY-LAYER WARMTH CONTRIBUTE TO RANGE OF MLCAPE FROM AROUND 500 J/KG OVER NRN WI WHERE CONVERGENCE IS STRONGER...TO NEAR 3000 J/KG OVER NERN IA IN MINIMAL LIFT. LSE VWP INDICATES FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR FOR AT LEAST TRANSIENT SUPERCELL CHARACTERISTICS...DESPITE VEERED/SWLY SFC FLOW IN AREA...WITH 0-1 KM SRH AROUND 150 J/KG AND 0-3 KM VALUES 250-300 J/KG. EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES AROUND 35-45 KT ARE EVIDENT OVER AREA. BAROCLINICITY WITH ERN BOUNDARY IS VERY SHARPLY DEFINED...AND BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD CONTINUE TO BECOME STABLE QUICKLY TO ITS E. AS SUCH...SPATIAL AND TEMPORAL WINDOW FOR SVR THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN RATHER LIMITED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INITIALLY SEPARATE AREAS OF STG-SVR TSTMS OVER NERN KS AND S-CENTRAL NEB ARE OCCURRING IN DIFFERENT ENVIRONMENTS...BUT MAY MERGE WITH CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING GUSTS DOWNSHEAR ACROSS N-CENTRAL/NERN KS AND S-CENTRAL/SERN NEB.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWED WEAK/HEAT-AIDED SFC LOW NEAR RSL...WITH TROUGH SWWD ACROSS SWRN KS NEAR GCK AND NEWD OVER SERN NEB NEAR BIE. SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT EXTENDED FROM CENTRAL IA SWWD ACROSS LNK AREA THEN WWD THROUGH WEAK FRONTAL WAVE INVOF LBF AND INTO NERN CO. FRONT SHOULD CONTINUE TO MOVE SLOWLY SEWD THROUGH EVENING...WITH SOMEWHAT LESS WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND HIGHER SFC DEW POINTS TO ITS IMMEDIATE N. IN THAT ENVIRONMENT...STG-SVR TSTM QUICKLY DEVELOPED N LXN...YIELDING REPORT OF 1.75 INCH HAIL AND BRIEF TORNADO AROUND 2217Z...WHILE NONSUPERCELL CHARACTER WAS EVIDENT EARLY IN ITS LIFESPAN. THIS ACTIVITY CURRENTLY RESIDES IN SMALL AREA WHERE OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SHOW MAXIMA IN SFC VORTICITY AND 0-3 KM AGL CAPE JUXTAPOSED INVOF FRONT. HOWEVER...FAVORABLE DEEP SHEAR -- E.G. 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES INDICATED BY MODIFIED MODEL SOUNDINGS -- INDICATES SOME POTENTIAL FOR THIS OR OTHER CONVECTION OVER THIS AREA TO BECOME SUPERCELLULAR...WITH RELATED ENHANCEMENT TO LARGE HAIL RISK. SUPERCELL TORNADO POTENTIAL IS MUCH MORE MRGL/CONDITIONAL BECAUSE OF WEAK LOW-LEVEL WINDS LIMITING HODOGRAPH SIZE...AND RELATED LACK OF SUBSTANTIAL SRH. INSTEAD...CONCERN IS THAT THIS ACTIVITY MAY INCREASE IN COVERAGE INVOF 2500-3500 J/KG MLCAPE AXIS THAT EXTENDS EWD ACROSS S-CENTRAL/SERN NEB...POSSIBLY ORGANIZING UPSCALE AND MERGING WITH INITIALLY SEPARATE NWRN KS CONVECTION. LATTER TSTMS ARE OCCURRING IN MUCH HOTTER/MORE DEEPLY MIXED ENVIRONMENT WITH WEAKER VERTICAL SHEAR. AS SUCH...KS CONVECTION HAS MORE POTENTIAL FOR SHORT-FUSED PRODUCTION OF STG-SVR OUTFLOW POOLS...BUT ALSO...GUST FRONTS MOVING QUICKLY AWAY FROM ORIGINATING CONVECTION. IN BETWEEN THESE TWO AREAS...MODIFIED RAOBS AND FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST RELATIVE MAX IN MLCINH...CASTING FURTHER UNCERTAINTY ON EVOLUTION OF CON

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED PAIR OF SVR TSTMS CROSSING ND-SD BORDER NNW ABR...AS OF 2330Z...MAY MAINTAIN LARGE-HAIL THREAT FOR 2-3 MORE HOURS WHILE MOVING SEWD ACROSS DISCUSSION AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL REPORTS OF SVR HAIL HAVE OCCURRED BETWEEN BIS AREA AND CURRENT POSITION OF THESE TSTMS. VEERED/NWLY SFC WINDS WILL CONTINUE TO LIMIT LOW-LEVEL SRH...HOWEVER FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL SPEED SHEAR AND DEEP-LAYER BULK SHEAR ARE EVIDENT FROM VWP AND MODIFIED FCST SOUNDINGS. ENHANCED GRADIENT FLOW AND FAVORABLE DCVA/UVV ALOFT ARE EVIDENT IMMEDIATELY SE OF PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH...INDICATED IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY MOVING ESEWD ACROSS NERN/S-CENTRAL ND AND N-CENTRAL SD. AS THIS FEATURE PROCEEDS TOWARD MN...PRECEDING BELT OF 45-55 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES SHOULD SHIFT/SPREAD EWD. MODIFIED FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST COMBINATION OF 80S F SFC TEMPS AND DESTABILIZATION ALOFT YIELDS ROUGHLY 1000 J/KG MLCAPE...WHICH SHOULD DIMINISH GRADUALLY AFTER 00Z AS DIABATICALLY COOLING NEAR-SFC LAYER DEEPENS. EXTENT TO WHICH STORM-SCALE PRESSURE PERTURBATIONS CAN MAINTAIN SUPERCELLULAR CHARACTERISTICS INTO INCREASING CINH IS UNCLEAR ATTM...BUT CONVECTION MAY PERSIST AS FAR AS SD/MN BORDER REGION AROUND 03Z BEFORE DISSIPATING. MEANWHILE...INTERMITTENT SVR HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLD SEVERE STORMS APPEARS TO BE DIMINISHING CONSIDERABLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LAST FEW HOURS OF RADAR MOSAIC DATA HAVE SHOWN A WEAKENING TREND IN WSWWD-MOVING STORMS OVER GILA COUNTY. THE 00Z/10 GREATER PHOENIX RAOB EXHIBITED A STOUT INVERSION AROUND H75 WITH SUBSTANTIAL CINH NEEDED TO OVERCOME FOR LIFTED PARCELS TO REACH THE LFC. DESPITE ADEQUATE ENELY MID-LEVEL FLOW ATOP WLY BOUNDARY LAYER WINDS...THE CINH AND ABSENCE OF SUBSTANTIAL FORCING FOR ASCENT ARE PROVING DETRIMENTAL TO STORMS MOVING INTO THE LOWER DESERT FROM THE HIGHER TERRAIN. IF CURRENT CONVECTIVE TRENDS CONTINUE...SEVERE WATCH 404 WILL LIKELY BE ALLOWED TO BE CANCELLED PRIOR TO THE 0500 UTC WATCH EXPIRATION TIME. ..SMITH.. 07/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PRIMARY AREA OF STG-SVR TSTMS OVER CENTRAL/E-CENTRAL KS MAY CONTINUE TO POSE RISK OF SVR WIND/HAIL AS IT MOVES ACROSS ERN KS AND PERHAPS INTO PORTIONS NRN MO...WHICH MAY REQUIRE WW. CONVECTION HAS DIMINISHED CONSIDERABLY OVER NEB AND NWRN KS...WITH BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZED BY COMBINATION OF OUTFLOW AND DIABATIC COOLING. AS SUCH...SOME OF THESE AREAS MAY BE CLEARED FROM WW IF NO OTHER SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTION DEVELOPS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC COLD FRONT WAS DRAWN FROM SWRN WI SWWD ACROSS SWRN IA TO KS/NEB BORDER BETWEEN MCK-HLC. FRONT HAS BECOME DIFFUSED SOMEWHAT BY OUTFLOW FROM EARLIER CONVECTION OVER S-CENTRAL NEB AND N-CENTRAL KS. WEAK/PREFRONTAL BOUNDARY IS EVIDENT IN SFC DATA AND REFLECTIVITY ANIMATIONS FROM CNK AREA ESEWD ACROSS NRN PORTIONS MKC METRO...WHERE IT HAS BEEN SUBTLY REINFORCED BY OUTFLOW FROM EARLIER/TRANSIENT TSTM THAT DEVELOPED THEREON. THIS BOUNDARY IS MOVING SWD ABOUT 10 KT IN PRECONVECTIVE AIR MASS...AND APPEARS TO BE FOCUSING ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT NEAR MHK AND BETWEEN MHK-TOP. MODIFIED TOP RAOB AND MODEL SOUNDINGS SUGGEST I-70 CORRIDOR LIES ALONG SRN RIM OF MOST FAVORABLE DEEP SHEAR AND BUOYANCY...WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES 40-50 KT N OF ABOUT A CNK-STJ-UIN LINE. THAT AREA SWD TO I-70 ALSO IS IN SRN GRADIENT OF ENHANCED BUOYANCY LOCATED OVER NERN KS AND NRN MO...WITH MLCAPE 2500-3000 J/KG FOR TSTMS THAT CAN ACCESS SFC-BASED EFFECTIVE INFLOW PARCELS. HOWEVER...CINH WILL INCREASING ACROSS THIS AREA GRADUALLY...GIVEN RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH SFC DEW POINTS COMMONLY 70S F. INCREASING/SWLY/30-35 KT LLJ WILL BE MAINTAINED OVER ERN KS AND CENTRAL/NRN MO FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS...HELPING TO MAINTAIN HIGH THETAE ABOVE SFC. SVR POTENTIAL DOWNSHEAR WILL BE DEPENDENT ON BETTER-ORGANIZED COLD POOL THAN IS EVIDENT AT PRESENT...TO MAXIMIZE FORCED ASCENT AND SUSTAINABLE FORWARD PROPAGATION. AS SUCH...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBILITY OF WW FARTHER E OVER MO. ..EDWARDS.. 07/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL POTENTIAL MAY DEVELOP EASTWARD FROM FAR NORTHEAST KS INTO NORTHERN/WESTERN MO OVERNIGHT...WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF A DEVELOPING DAMAGING WIND THREAT AS WELL MAINLY ACROSS NORTHWEST/NORTH-CENTRAL MO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LEADING EASTERN EDGE OF A STRONG CONVECTIVE CLUSTER HAS SHOWN SOME SIGNS OF INTENSIFICATION/INCREASING ORGANIZATION ACROSS FAR NORTHEAST KS EARLY IN THE OVERNIGHT. TO ITS EAST...THE BOUNDARY LAYER REMAINS RELATIVELY WARM/MOIST WITH TEMPERATURES AND DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER-MIDDLE 80S/LOWER 70S F RESPECTIVELY...ALTHOUGH BOUNDARY LAYER CINH CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY INCREASE. MLCAPE REMAINS BETWEEN 2500-3500 J/KG NEAR AN EFFECTIVE FRONTAL ZONE THAT EXTENDS FROM FAR NORTHEAST KS NORTHEASTWARD INTO NORTHERN MO/SOUTHEAST IA. THESE STORMS MAY CONTINUE TO EXPAND GENERALLY EASTWARD OVERNIGHT ALONG THIS FRONTAL ZONE/INSTABILITY GRADIENT...WITH AID OF A MODERATE WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY LOW LEVEL JET/ISENTROPIC ASCENT REGIME. HAIL POTENTIALLY TO SEVERE LEVELS WILL BE A POSSIBILITY INTO NORTHERN/WESTERN MO GIVEN AMPLE INSTABILITY/STEEP LAPSE RATES AND SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR...AND SOME DAMAGING WIND THREAT /PERHAPS EVEN INCREASING/ CANNOT BE ENTIRELY DISCOUNTED EVEN WITH INCREASING CINH GIVEN THE STEEPNESS OF THE LAPSE RATES...ESPECIALLY IF ADDITIONAL COLD POOL EXPANSION/FORWARD PROPAGATION OCCURS.
